title: (the tablet's timeline, found 11-21 by the speed measure) the Android host writes no game-frame and no step-wait timeline events: native/host/host_main.cpp records GameFrame inside `#if defined(_WIN32)` (svc_frame_begun) and StepWaitBegin and StepWaitEnd inside `#if defined(_WIN32) && defined(NEBULA_HOST_RENDERER)`, and the SDL branch of the step loop records none. The tablet's speed measure therefore finds the stage's first frame by the render thread's content-time events and takes step_ms and step_p99_ms from the [pace] lines: the median over the ten-second windows of their average step work and of their 99th percentile. Those are no true median or 99th percentile of a step's work.
note: Found by T7a (B2a, B2b). The game is not changed by that work.

title: (the tablet's pacing report, found 11-21 by the speed measure) the [pace] lines of the tablet's measure run report refresh_ms=33.333 (30 Hz) while the same run's presents came about every 9 ms (the timeline's median gap 9.4 ms, 99th percentile 18.9 ms). Not looked into.
